scientific_question: Can differentiation through the MFSI construction design a better rank-three measured-observable equivalence class than the hand fiber?
primary_metric: integral of Ritz correction energy plus 0.02 times forcing power plus the ESS-floor penalty

observable_family.dictionary: the three original radial RBFs followed by the fixed eight-function radial Ritz dictionary
observable_family.rank_constraint: Euclidean row-orthonormal rank-three coefficients in a common bounded radial-RBF dictionary
observable_family.endpoint_constraint: each coefficient vector is in the nullspace of the fixed weighted endpoint dictionary-mean difference
observable_family.hand_control: optimizer step zero is an invertible reparameterization of the original three-observable fiber

selection_rule: minimum independent selection-bank objective among steps 0,5,...,40
frozen: converged 640-step exponential calibration and numerical ridges
adaptation, selection, and evaluation bank realizations shared by both methods
